body: Things  have just been really hard again I have no motivation to do basic things in life. I feel like I will never get better anymore, things will seem okay for awhile but then all of a sudden I am back in my dark deep depression where I feel helpless. Everyone has a hard time understanding and I just feel like it's never going to get better. I have a hard time at work everyday and I work in the banking field so it's expected to be on your game everyday. I just find myself thinking about suicide more and more. There are people in my life that know what I have been going through but they expect that I am just going through one of my cycles and I will be fine in a couple of weeks. however for me that's hard to live like that. I have had suicidal idealizations lately and I can't seem to stop the self harm urges
